{{Top}} {{Otheruses}} {{Character |type=CIS |image=[[File:AdmiralTrenchHS-SWCT.png]] |option1=19 BBY |image2=[[File:AdmiralTrenchofChristophsis-TotOR2023.png]] |option2=22 BBY |name=Trench |homeworld=[[Secundus Ando]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' |birth= |death=[[19 BBY]], ''[[Invulnerable]]'', [[Azure system]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[Battle of Anaxes]], during which Trench [[Death|dies]] aboard ''[[Invulnerable]]'' in the [[Azure system]] according to "[[Unfinished Business (episode)|Unfinished Business]]," to [[19 BBY]]. |species=[[Harch]]{{Databank|admiral-trench|Admiral Trench}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |height=1.89 [[meter]]s {{C|6 [[Foot|ft]], 2 in}}''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]]{{TCW|Cat and Mouse}} |feathers= |eyes=Red |skin=Gray |cyber=*Left side of head {{C|including left [[eye]] and chelicera}}{{TCW|The Unknown}} *All three left [[Limb|arms]] **One with electronet launcher{{TCW|Unfinished Business (episode)}} |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Corporate Alliance]]''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' **[[Corporate fleet (Malastare)|Corporate fleet]] *[[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] **[[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|I smell fear, and it smells good.|Trench|audio=ISmellFear-CaM.flac|}} '''Trench''' was a [[Harch]] [[admiral]] and naval [[commander]] who survived a number of presumed [[death]]s throughout his career. Hailing from [[Secundus Ando]], he acquitted himself in engagements with the [[Galactic Republic]], all the while savoring the terror he struck in his enemies. [[Standard year|Years]] after his purported death at the [[Battle of Malastare Narrows]] of [[34 BBY]], he resurfaced during the [[Clone Wars]], becoming a key [[officer]] in the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems Navy|navy]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. From the [[Providence-class Dreadnought|dreadnought]] ''[[Invincible]]'' he oversaw the Confederate [[blockade]] of [[Christophsis]], which brought him into [[Battle of Christophsis|conflict]] with a Republic [[Fleet|battle group]] led by [[Jedi General]]s [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]] along with an old foe, Admiral [[Wullf Yularen]]. When Skywalker and Yularen attempted to use an experimental [[IPV-2C Stealth Corvette|stealth ship]] to breach the blockade, Trench began a deadly game of cat and mouse with them. Though Skywalker outwitted him by redirecting a volley of [[tracking torpedo]]es back at the ''Invincible'', Trench managed to survive his [[flagship]]'s demise. During the [[Battle of Ringo Vinda]], Trench captured [[clone trooper]] [[Tup]]—who had mysteriously gunned down [[Jedi]] [[General]] [[Tiplar]]—and tried to send the [[Cloning|clone]] to Separatist leader [[Count]] [[Dooku]] for examination, though a Republic team intervened and rescued Tup. In the [[Battle of Anaxes]], Trench besieged the [[Anaxes shipyards|Republic shipyards]] at [[Anaxes]] for [[Standard week|weeks]] on end, exploiting the [[Techno Union]]'s [[Echo|secret access]] to a Republic [[Rex's battle strategy algorithm|strategy algorithm]]. Even as the tide of battle began to turn, Trench remained intent on annihilating the Jedi and their clone infantry. Though he activated a bomb beneath the [[Anaxes assembly complex|assembly complex]] on Anaxes, Skywalker infiltrated Trench's flagship, the ''[[Invulnerable]]'' and forced the admiral to divulge the sequence to disarm the device. When Trench tried to retaliate, Skywalker drove his [[Skywalker lightsaber|lightsaber]] through his chest, inflicting a death that even the hardened Harch could not escape. ==Biography== ===Early life=== [[File:Trench_symbol.svg|thumb|left|124px|Trench's personal symbol]] Trench was a [[Gender|male]] [[Harch]] who [[Homeworld|hailed]] from [[Secundus Ando]]. Trench served in multiple battles throughout his military career, mostly in [[cruiser]]–to–cruiser action. In some of these battles he would fight against forces utilizing [[Cloaking device|cloaked]] [[starship]]s, defeating them through the use of [[tracking torpedo]]es fixed on the vessels' magnetic signatures. Trench eventually rose to command a [[Corporate fleet (Malastare)|corporate fleet]] that [[Battle of Malastare Narrows|blockaded]] the [[planet]] [[Malastare]] in [[34 BBY]].''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Trench was able to hold his lines against a [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[fleet]] led by [[Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]] sent to break the [[blockade]], tearing their ships apart. However, a [[Jedi]]-led taskforce commanded by [[Jedi Master|Master]] [[Kep-She]] was able to defeat Trench, vaporizing his flagship and seemingly [[Death|killing]] him in the process. However, Trench survived the battle with the help of his species' hardy biology as well as a damaged pressure suit.[[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 106|''The Official Star Wars Fact File'' Part 106]] ===Clone Wars=== ====Blockade of Christophsis==== {{Quote|Turn back now. Retreat while you can, for I am your doom.|Trench|audio=AdmiralDoom-CaM.flac|}} [[File:AdmiralTrench-SWM42.png|thumb|right|330px|As the battle unfolded, Trench decreed "''I smell fear, and it smells good.''"]] Trench, along with his [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|tactical droid]], [[TI-99]], were later sent to [[Christophsis]] to assist [[General]] [[Whorm Loathsom|Loathsom]] and [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s [[assassin]], [[Asajj Ventress]] in seizing the [[planet]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Confederacy]], and [[Battle of Christophsis|blockading]] the planet to tighten their grip on the system.{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}} There, he commanded the [[Christophsis blockade|blockade]] from his war-painted flagship, the ''[[Invincible]]'', to prevent [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] and other republic relief forces from being resupplied and to cripple any attempts to penetrate the blockade. Trench then held his lines against [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]]'s fleet. Trench then watched as the [[Grand Army of the Republic|Republic fleet]] retreated behind the [[moon]] and had his force recharge their [[cannon]]s. While the Jedi retreated and regrouped, Trench felt that he had won the first round. His tactical droid was puzzled and asked Trench if they should pursue. The Admiral instead ordered his troops not to follow the enemy, as per the commands he was issued by higher authority. After this, Trench commanded his droids to recycle the ship's shields and allow the cannons to recharge to full power. The Admiral, satisfied with the proceedings, seated himself at the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] and awaited for the return of the Republic ships. [[File:AdmiralTrench-TCWs2BR3.png|thumb|left|220px|Admiral Trench giving orders]] However, Trench's old adversary from [[Malastare Narrows]], [[Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]], was also present with Skywalker at the battle. After recognizing [[Trench's crest|Trench's trademark insignia and crest]] painted on his flagship, Yularen studied everything [[Republic Intelligence]] had provided on the Admiral's tactics, allowing him to plan a counter-attack. This came in the form of an experimental stealth ship, piloted by Anakin Skywalker himself and Admiral Yularen as an adviser. Unaware of the existence and capabilities of the cloaked ship, Trench then grew impatient with the Republic fleet, and to put pressure on them to attack, he sent a squadron of [[Hyena-class Droid Fighter/Bomber|Hyena bombers]] to attack Organa's [[refugee]] camp, particularly the command center as a plan to draw out the Republic on the surface who Trench viewed as "cowards." When the Republic fleet did not attack, Trench understood that something odd was happening. Trench then spotted a [[IPV-2C Stealth Corvette|cloaked ship]] moving to attack him. Trench and his crew were then able to raise the ''Invincible''{{'s}} [[thermal shield]]s. Trench fired torpedoes at the stealth ship, but missed. Trench then ordered a volley of [[laser]]s to be fired at it, and since no shots landed, Trench was able to deduce that the [[pilot]] was a Jedi, not a [[Clone trooper|clone]]. Trench sent a message to Skywalker, telling him that he had dealt with cloaked ships before. He also gloated that Christophsis' citizens and resources would join the Separatist Alliance. Trench also told Skywalker to retreat, for he was his doom. Trench prepared himself for the Jedi's inevitable second offensive. Eventually the cloaked vessel revealed itself, but this time, the crew had knowledge of Trench's tactics when dealing with cloaked ships. [[File:Trench_2.png|thumb|right|220x220px|Trench accepting his fate]] After Skywalker attacked, Trench was able to track the ship's magnetic signature using [[tracking torpedo]]es so he could follow and destroy them. At first, Trench's tactic worked. However, he would be forced to lower his shields to do so and the droid advised that such a maneuver would be unwise. In a moment of compulsive anger and against the droid's advice, Trench gave the order and the torpedoes were launched. After seemingly attempting to elude the missiles, Skywalker then flew the ship directly towards the ''Invincible''{{'s}} bridge. A horrified Trench then realized what Skywalker was intending and desperately ordered the shields raised, but to no avail as they were recharging. Left with no option to retaliate or escape, Trench accepted his fate and closed his eyes as his own torpedoes slammed into the bridge of the ''Invincible'', destroying the flagship in moments; Despite this, Trench was able to survive a second time but he did not come out of this second Jedi-led defeat unscathed; he lost his left [[eye]], left cheek mandible and all three of his left [[Limb|arms]], all of which required cybernetic replacements. ====Battle of Ringo Vinda==== {{Quote|It seemed that at the height of the conflict, a clone turned on his Jedi General and…executed her.''"
"''Intentionally?''"
"''I saw it with my own eyes.|Trench and Dooku, on the death of Jedi Master Tiplar|}} [[File:Admiral-trench-count-dooku.png|thumb|left|270x270px|Trench speaks with Dooku]] Trench, alongside the [[ST-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|super tactical droid]] [[Kraken]], later commanded the [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]] on the [[Ringo Vinda space station|space station]] at [[Ringo Vinda]] [[Battle of Ringo Vinda|against]] Jedi Generals [[Tiplee]], [[Tiplar]], Skywalker, and their [[Cloning|clone]] forces. Trench took Kraken as his advisor over another T-series tactical droid as he knew the planet's complex environment, combined with the constant fluidity of control over territory aboard, meant he would make full use of Kraken's assistance.{{BuildR2Cite|51|Droid Directory}} As the Republic came close to breaking his lines, Trench witnessed [[Tup|one of the clone troopers]] kill General Tiplar, causing the Republic to retreat. Trench then contacted Count Dooku and described his observations, telling him that the clone looked "like he was in a trance of some kind". Trench's observation for minor details proved vital as it allowed Dooku and his [[Sith Master]], [[Darth Sidious]], to create a cover-up before the Jedi Order could discover the existence of [[Order 66|Protocol 66]]. Trench then had Kraken capture and deliver the clone to Dooku, despite the Republic's [[blockade]]. After successfully kidnapping the clone trooper "Tup", the Count applauded the Harch's success, Trench then tasked Kraken to personally escort the captured Clone to Dooku himself. However, the mission failed as the Republic recaptured Tup and Kraken was decapitated by Skywalker. Following the recapture of Tup, the Republic eventually withdrew its forces from Ringo Vinda. Without realizing it, Trench's attention to detail would prove important to the [[Grand Plan|Sith plan]] behind the Clone Wars.{{EncyclopediaCite|The Separatists}} ====Battle for Anaxes==== {{Quote|Tell me the sequence to disarm the bomb!''"
"''Never. Dooku would ''kill'' me for losing Anaxes.''"
"''And you think I ''won't''?''"
"''You're a Jedi. Your nobility--|Skywalker and Trench|}} [[File:Trench_death_tcw_s7_final.png|thumb|right|252x252px|Admiral Trench meets his demise after being interrogated by Anakin aboard his flagship.]] During the later phases of the [[Clone Wars]], Trench, now on the offensive, commanded the Confederate forces during the [[Battle of Anaxes]],{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}} fighting for the Republic's vital shipyards on [[Anaxes]] in a campaign which lasted for several weeks. Trench used his own tactical acumen, as well as using [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex|CT-7567's]] [[Rex's battle strategy algorithm|strategy algorithm]] against them using the [[Techno Union]]'s test subject on Skako Minor, a captured [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] named "[[Echo]]." Skywalker, Rex, and [[Clone Force 99]] rescued Echo from the Techno Union, but Trench was not made aware of this because of [[Wat Tambor]]'s greed.{{TCW|A Distant Echo}} When the Republic attacked Anaxes again, Trench had expected an easy rout by the Republic forces, only to be surprised when the entire force at the plant was disabled. In response, he went to his backup plan; a bomb in the [[Anaxes assembly complex]] that would rip the planet apart. Echo attempted to decipher the sequence to disarm the bomb, but the jamming signal incapacitated him before he could decipher the last number for [[Mace Windu]], who was leading the Republic forces at the complex. Skywalker, having anticipated Echo would be unable to complete the job, forced his way to the dreadnought's bridge, where he cut down Trench's [[Unidentified super tactical droid (Anaxes)|super tactical droid]] and accompanying [[BX-series droid commando]]s. Skywalker then threatened Trench for the last number, but the Harch refused, claiming that Dooku would kill him if he lost Anaxes. When Skywalker threatened to do it instead, Trench called his bluff, assuming that Skywalker would accede to Jedi nobility, only to be proven wrong when Skywalker sliced off his left arms proclaiming that he did not possess "such weaknesses", prompting him to quickly give up the number. As Skywalker relayed it to Windu, Trench attempted to electrocute him with his staff, but Skywalker resisted and ran the Harch through the chest with his lightsaber, fatally wounding him. Skywalker then grabbed the dreadnought's self-destruct detonator and indifferently bid the Admiral farewell as he dropped dead. Trench's body was subsequently vaporized when the clone commando Wrecker triggered his flagship's self-destruct, wiping out the ''Invulnerable'' and most of its surrounding fleet. Trench's legendary career came to an end, and his death was a devastating blow for the Separatists.''[[Skywalker: A Family at War]]'' However, the Separatist Army, led by General [[Grievous]], had forced the deployment of numerous Jedi generals throughout the [[Outer Rim]], and the vast majority of fronts remained open.{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} ====Legacy==== Although Trench's Christophsis flagship, ''Invincible'', was destroyed by Anakin Skywalker in a cloaked stealth ship during the Battle of Christophsis, some of the flagship's modules were salvaged and used to modify a [[Berch Teller's warship|Separatist dreadnought]] owned by [[Berch Teller]]'s [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|rebel cell]] to [[Attack on Sentinel Base|attack]] the [[Galactic Empire|Empire's]] [[Sentinel Base]] in [[14 BBY]].[[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] During the [[New Republic Era]], Trench was mentioned as having been a notable Harch in "[[Species From A to Z]]," a survival compendium sent out by [[Carson Teva]].{{GermanFanCite|112|Database}} ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|My personal strategy for victory is through total annihilation.|Trench|}} [[File:TrenchFile-CatAndMouse.png|thumb|left|242x242px|Trench's file brought up by Yularen including his signature crest seen emblazoned on his flagship.]] Trench was a 1.89 [[meter]] (6 [[Foot|feet]], 2 inches) tall, Harch male, with brown [[hair]], red eyes and gray skin. After the Battle of Christophsis, the left side of his head became cybernetic, including the left eye and chelicera as well as his left mandible. Trench's cybernetic replacements also included all three left arms and one electronet launcher. Trench was a fearsome Harch admiral who was far larger than the average member of his species, as the arachnids seldom grew to such size due their [[Skeleton|exoskeletons]] not being able to bear the weight of the [[Hair|fur]]. He was a well-decorated military genius and his aggressive tactics and maneuvers in combat made him responsible for the destruction of many Republic fleets. Admiral Trench became a terror on the battlefield, as he held no mercy or remorse toward his opponents. His skill in hunting cloaked ships through the use of tracking magnetic signatures was also noted and recorded in the [[Republic Intelligence]] record, which was studied during the blockade of Christophsis by Admiral [[Wullf Yularen|Yularen]]. Admiral Trench had a distinctive [[Trench's crest|crest]], resembling his face, emblazoned on all of his ships. [[File:SWUPhase2-Trench.png|thumb|right|300px|Trench was a brilliant and ruthless tactician.]] Trench prided himself for having won many battles in the war as a result of his tactical acumen, resulting in him developing an overconfident personality and often boasting about outsmarting his opponents. Trench often viewed his battles like a game and would often cajole and taunt his enemies as he made his moves, before leading them into a vulnerable position where he could eliminate them. However, his overconfidence nearly led to his own demise at the hands of Anakin Skywalker when he made an uncharacteristic oversight which left himself vulnerable to incoming missiles. Even when his death appeared imminent, Trench did not panic or show distress; he simply accepted his fate. Following his defeat, Trench was immediately fitted with "top-of-the-line" [[cybernetics]] making up half of his limbs and face to ensure his quick return to service. Trench, learning from his mistakes of lowering his guard, carried an electrostaff-cane variant as well as one of his cybernetic arms being equipped with a [[stun net]] which he used against Skywalker prior to his demise. Trench, Grievous, and their colleague commanders manage the overall campaign objectives, whereas Ventress employed deceit, bribery, robbery, and targeted killing to achieve her finer ends.''[[Rise of the Separatists]]'' Only Trench and a handful of brilliant sentients remain in charge of offensive operations, as Grievous has more precise command over his army, thanks to the droid commanders removing unauthorized thoughts and suggestions from underlings with lesser strategic prowess.''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' [[File:AdmiralTrench-CotR.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Trench was loyal to the CIS and made use of cybernetics to stay alive]] On Ringo Vinda, the planet's complex environment, combined with the constant fluidity of control over territory aboard the ringed space station, meant Trench needed the assistance of another tactical droid. This time, he opted for the superior ST-series super tactical droid over another T-series model, and Commander Kraken was vital in assisting the admiral in their campaign against the Republic. When confronted and threatened by Anakin Skywalker, Trench initially refused to capitulate to his demands as it would mean his death at Dooku's hands for losing Anaxes to the Republic, persisting in his defiance by confidently asserting that Skywalker's Jedi nobility would prevent him from striking down an unarmed opponent. When Skywalker proved that he wasn't bluffing by ruthlessly slicing off Trench's prosthetic limbs, however, the Admiral quickly relented and gave up the final number. Despite this, he did try and take advantage of Skywalker's distraction to attack him with his electric cane, a move that proved to be futile and fatal in short order. ==Flagships== ===Trench's first ship=== Trench's first flagship was part of a corporate fleet which was present at the Battle of Malastare Narrows where Trench blockaded the planet and engaged Wullf Yularen's republic fleet which was successful until a Jedi-led task force intervened and sabotaged his campaign. It was believed that he had gone down with his ship, but this was later proven false at the Battle of Christophsis in [[22 BBY]]. ===The ''Invincible''=== [[File:Invincible2-TCWs2BR3.png|thumb|right|175x175px]] The ''Invincible'' served as the Harch commander's command ship after his reemergence where it blockaded the planet of Christophsis, offering a great range of attacks, and it was said that the cruiser could blockade a planet on its own. Unlike the stock variant of a Separatist dreadnought; Trench's was well-equipped with heavy deflector and thermal shields which allowed for a powerful defense. However, Trench underestimated the opposing commander, General Anakin Skywalker, resulting in him losing the upper hand and Anakin taking advantage of the Admiral's temper by redirecting Trench's projectiles to the bridge of his ship. ===The ''Invulnerable''=== The ''[[Invulnerable]]'' was the last flagship used by Admiral Trench, witnessing action during the Battle of Anaxes. Onboard, he received transmissions of a stolen Republic strategy algorithm from the planet [[Skako Minor]], routed through a [[Cyber Center]] on the surface of Anaxes, and used it to counter the Republic's moves. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Trenchbadbatch.png|thumb|left|250px|Admiral Trench as he appears in the opening newsreel of the episode "The Bad Batch" in story reel format.]] Admiral Trench was created for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series and first appeared in the second season of the series, in the episode "[[Cat and Mouse]]", released in [[2010]]. He was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]], who also voiced the [[clone trooper]]s in the series. Trench was designed by [[Wayne Lo]].{{ArtStation|username=phattro|name=[[Pat Presley]]|url=artwork/rRq2yG|date=2020-04-14|quote=-Admiral Trench B- Star Wars: The Clone Wars- I helped design the cybernetic-enhanced version of Admiral Trench that made appearance in the final season of The Clone Wars. The new Trench was art directed by Dave Filoni and Kilian Plunkett, and based on the brilliant original design by Wayne Lo. The design was to give him a new set of limps and partial face that pays a bit of homage (and foreshadow) to Vader. We also wanted a sense of aristocracy with the decorative pattern on his cybernetics. Fans of the show may notice that new Trench is voided of military honors, it was a design decision to hint that he was stripped of all his honors by Dooku after his previous failure. It was cool to see him in action again. The Harch Admiral lived to die another day. Stay safe and sane, everyone! Cheers.|archivefile=File:PatPresley-Trench-ArtStation.png}} His name was originally going to be "Taranch" as a more obvious nod to the name of the arachnid species [[Wikipedia:tarantula|tarantula]], from which his design is derived.{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/cat-and-mouse-episode-guide|text="Cat and Mouse" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} Even though the name was dropped, it is still present in the Trench's record, though spelled in [[Aurebesh]]. Trench was confirmed to have survived "Cat and Mouse" and made his return in the series in the [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]] episode "[[The Unknown]]", where Trench is alive with half his body consisting of cybernetics. The episode was released in [[2014]]{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-the-lost-missions-now-on-netflix|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Lost Missions Now on Netflix|nolive=1}} after the series' cancellation the [[2013|year prior]].{{SW|url=news/a-new-direction-for-lucasfilm-animation|text=A New Direction for Lucasfilm Animation}} Concept art of the character's new appearance and his updated model were done by [[Pat Presley]]{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/unfinished-business-episode-guide|text="Unfinished Business" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} under the direction by supervising director [[Dave Filoni]] and lead character designer [[Kilian Plunkett]] and finished on [[September 29]], [[2011]]. Similar to General Grievous and [[Maul]] in the series, Trench's cybernetics were meant as an homage and foreshadowing to Darth Vader and the decorative patterns on them were also meant to give a sense of aristocracy. Additionally, ''The Clone Wars'' writer [[Brent Friedman]] confirmed on his [[Wikipedia:Twitter|Twitter]] account in 2013 that he wrote a [[The Clone Wars Legacy#Bad Batch|four-part episode arc]] that wasn't published that featured Trench.{{Twitter|BFree63|status/353962107764609024|[[Brent Friedman]]|date=2013-07-07|quote=One of the arcs I wrote, one you'll sadly never see, featured Trench. But really don't remember if the Order 66 arc does.|archivedate=20200814155155}} The episode arc was screened at [[Celebration Anaheim (2015)|Celebration Anaheim]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' convention as story reel form apart of ''[[The Clone Wars Legacy]]'' project in [[2015]], which featured the return and death of Admiral Trench and the episodes were later released on [[StarWars.com]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-bad-batch-recon|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' "Bad Batch" Recon|nolive=1}} Trench's deaths was meant to mimic the death of real spiders. The unfinished episodes later aired as part of the revival in [[2020]].
